request: Mobile versions of three unselected desktop concepts
tool: built-in image_gen, default model, transparent_background false

prompts.name: Mobile personal index
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Draw a responsive MOBILE version of the attached toli.me desktop concept. One coherent mobile webpage per image. Target natural scrolling mobile page 390 CSS px wide and approximately1170 CSS px tall, portrait3:1 canvas; output about1024x3072 pixels. This is a long mobile scroll screenshot, not a desktop page squeezed into a phone. No bezel, hardware, notch, OS/status bar, browser chrome, outer device/card/shadow. Current date October8,2026. Match warm cream#fcfaf1, forest#102e29, muted leaf green, thin separators, Cormorant-style serif headings and Georgia body. Realistic mobile text16px body, section headings26px, hero headline40px, project titles20px, generous tap areas, no horizontal overflow. Use compact spacing and thumb sizes to fit the scrolling view naturally; do not stretch or squash desktop imagery.
Header “toli.me.” on left and simple “Menu” on right. Hero “Hi, I’m Toli.” with attached ORIGINAL laughing black-shirt portrait upright in80px CIRCULAR frame top right; same likeness, no new photo scene, no oval or rotation, never covering title or intro. Introduction below heading/photo on its own full-width row: “Stories, strange little creations, and things I’ve learned along the way.”
First section MUST be “Main projects” with three compact vertically stacked rows, thumbnail LEFT then name/short description RIGHT: “Drawn” / “Life, in comic form.”; “Neurodiverse Guide” / “Making work work for different minds.” / “(and my YouTube talk)”; “Dating Bounty” / “A very personal side project.” Keep attached recognizable comic/book/envelope art. No three tiny columns on phone.
Creative immediately follows, same thumb-left rows as Writing, not huge preview cards: “Easter Creatures” / “Creature drawings and a Miami art experiment.” (actual attached sketch); “Las Chicas” / “An art workshop in Granada, Nicaragua.” (actual attached workshop photo); “Spa Date” / “A playful invitation to a spa date.” (small bath icon); “Obscure Parody Videos” / “A detour into the wonderfully obscure.” / “Currently private on YouTube.” (small film icon). Link “All creative →”.
Writing below: “Energy Cords and Foreign Energy in your Aura” / “Choosing what to let go.” and “Rejection, Breakups, Vulnerability, and BDSM” / “Learning to ask and stay open to love.” Use attached ORIGINAL blue Energy artwork and actual author portrait as thumbnails, not invented plants, beaches or notebooks. Link “All writing →”. Optional small About/Now content per concept, clearly draft; proposed Now text “Comics, creativity, and making work work for different minds.” dated “October2026 · draft”. Footer “Say hello ↗” / “toli@toli.me”. Omit invented photo strip and all quotations. No new features, metrics, badges, stock photos, fictitious testimonials or extra claims. Maintain same visual identity and hierarchy as desktop reference while adapting layout, typography and spacing for an actual narrow phone page.
Mobile direction: Faithful single-column version. Brief draft About sentence just below introduction: “I build things, draw comics, and collect strange little ideas.” Main project rows, Creative rows, Writing, then quiet Now footer note. Keep all content compact, without enclosing cards.
